Auth.//: Validates the JWTs AlertsHub requires (TASK-031). Authority is deliberately unset: the Auth Service publishes a JWKS document but no OpenID discovery document, so the issuer is pinned here instead of being learned from metadata. Port 5091 is the Auth Service's local profile; TASK-047 replaces it with the compose service address.

Cors.//: TASK-042: the frontend's Vite dev-server origin. TASK-047 replaces this with the compose frontend address.

RabbitMq.//: TASK-043: dedicated vhost, least-privilege user scoped to readings.stored (consume only; alert dispatch is in-process, no publish here).
